## What changes and why?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue if there is one.

## Verification

List the commands and results, OS/architecture, and any checks you could not run. For process-control work, use deliberately launched harmless targets and temporary data.

## User-facing impact

Include screenshots for UI changes, ideally in both themes. Note changes to timing, startup, quitting, permissions, storage compatibility, or privacy.

## Checklist

- [ ] This PR addresses one clear problem.
- [ ] Relevant checks were run, or missing checks are explained.
- [ ] Documentation reflects changed behavior.
- [ ] Personal data and credentials are removed from reports and screenshots.
- [ ] I have permission to contribute this work under the project's license.
